selfUpdate.title: MaiBot Update
selfUpdate.dependenciesChanged: This update changes dependencies; they will be synced automatically ({{tool}})
selfUpdate.cannotApply: Automatic update is not possible right now
selfUpdate.confirmDesc: MaiBot will be offline for a few minutes: it stops, pulls the new version, syncs dependencies and starts again. If pulling or syncing dependencies fails, it rolls back to the current version automatically. Backing up the data directory first is recommended.
selfUpdate.overlayDesc: Pulling the new version and syncing dependencies. This may take a few minutes; do not close MaiBot
selfUpdate.sourceHint: Sources are tried in the order of the plugin marketplace mirror settings; only the official repository Mai-with-u/MaiBot is pulled
selfUpdate.packageSourceHint: Install stable releases from PyPI. Configuration and databases are backed up; stop other instances sharing this environment first.
selfUpdate.packageConfirmDesc: MaiBot will be offline for a few minutes. It backs up configuration and databases, installs the confirmed version with uv, and restarts. Installation verification failures trigger an attempt to restore the previous package and dependencies. Backups are in data/self_update/backups. Database migrations after the new version starts are not automatically reversed.
selfUpdate.rolledBack: Rolled back to the previous version automatically
selfUpdate.rollbackFailed: Automatic rollback failed; check the repository and dependencies manually: {{error}}
selfUpdate.toastFailedDesc: Update failed. See Settings → About for details.

blockers.uv_missing: uv was not found; add it to the startup PATH

blockers.package_runner_missing: Start with maibot run to enable automatic updates
blockers.other_instances_running: Stop other MaiBot instances sharing this tool environment first
blockers.package_busy: The tool environment is updating; try again later
blockers.git_missing: Git was not found, so self-update is unavailable
blockers.not_git_repo: This deployment is not a Git repository (e.g. a Docker image or an archive); update it the way it was deployed
blockers.detached_head: Not on any branch (detached HEAD), so self-update is unavailable
blockers.unsupported_branch: Self-update is only supported on the main or dev branch
blockers.dirty_worktree: There are uncommitted local changes; commit or revert them first
blockers.diverged: There are local commits that the official branch does not have, so a fast-forward update is impossible
blockers.no_dependency_tool: This update changes dependencies, but no way to install them was found (uv or pip)
blockers.python_requirement_changed: This update changes the required Python version; please update manually

files.disabled: File capabilities are disabled. Enable them in Capabilities.
files.title: Files
files.description: Files belong to chats and download on demand. Preview text; uploaded and generated originals remain until manually deleted.
files.confirmDelete: Delete “{{name}}”? Local originals cannot be recovered.
files.removeAttachment: Remove attachment from draft (original stays in Files)

delivery.unknown: Delivery is uncertain. Check the chat before retrying.

hostShared.title: Shared model catalog
hostShared.hint: The host shares providers, keys and models. Each Bot keeps its task choices; local entries override shared names. Running Bots reload shared changes.
hostShared.importHint: Import fills this editor; save to publish. Inherit removes identical local copies only, preserving task choices and different local overrides.
hostShared.adopted: Removed {{count}} identical local copies. Running Bots reload automatically.
hostShared.saved: Catalog saved. Running Bots will reload automatically.
hostShared.name: Name
hostShared.inherited: These entries come from the host. Editing creates an override for this Bot. Manage shared entries in Bot management → Shared model catalog.
hostShared.gateway: Unified message endpoints (configure this Bot’s token / API key)

hostOperations.renameHint: Change the host display name only; the Bot ID, directory and persona name stay unchanged.
hostOperations.cloneHint: Temporarily stop the source, copy configuration and plugins, then restore its desired state. History, memory, login state and logs are excluded. The clone stays stopped; review accounts and credentials before starting it.
hostOperations.archiveHint: Stop this Bot, move its directory into host/archives and remove its registration. Data is retained.
hostOperations.unregisterHint: Stop and unregister this Bot. Its original or external directory stays in place.
hostOperations.updateHint: Update the program shared by all Bots. Stop all Bots and the host, then restart after success or a safe rollback and restore desired states.
hostOperations.restarting: The host is updating and restarting. Waiting to reconnect. If rollback fails, check the terminal and restart manually after repair.

personality.title: Personality
personality.content: Describe who the bot is here. Its character, identity and point of view all come from this field. Try editing it right in the highlight.

replyStyle.title: Reply style
replyStyle.content: Controls the tone and length of replies, such as shorter, livelier or more formal. Remember to save after editing.

talkValue.title: Group talk frequency
talkValue.content: How often the bot speaks up in group chats. Lower values make it quieter. Adjust this if it talks too much or too little.

plugins.title: Plugin market
plugins.content: Search for and install plugins here to give the bot new abilities. Installed plugins can be tuned under Plugin Config.

knowledgeBase.title: Knowledge base
knowledgeBase.content: Import material under Import / Export. The bot refers to it while chatting and also builds up memories from conversations.

done.title: That's the basics
done.content: Everything you changed lives in the sidebar menu, so you can come back and adjust it anytime. Now go chat with the bot!
